Container.Name: HytaleServerManager
Container.Overview:
Hytale Server Manager is a web-based dashboard for managing Hytale game servers. Features include real-time console access, server monitoring and metrics, mod management via Modtale, automated backup scheduling, player tracking, scheduled tasks, Discord webhook notifications, and role-based permissions (admin/moderator/viewer).
IMPORTANT: Before starting, generate the three required secrets and paste them into the environment variables below: JWT_SECRET: openssl rand -hex 64 JWT_REFRESH_SECRET: openssl rand -hex 64 SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY: openssl rand -hex 16
Default login: username "admin", password "Admin123!@#" — change immediately after first login.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: JWT authentication secret. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 64

Config.Name: JWT Refresh Secret
Config.Description: JWT refresh token secret. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 64

Config.Name: Settings Encryption Key
Config.Description: 32-character hex encryption key for settings. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 16

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Application environment.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on. Must match the host port if using host networking.

Config.Name: CORS Origin
Config.Description: Allowed CORS origin. Set to your server's IP/hostname and port, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:3001

Config.Name: Insecure Cookies (HTTP)
Config.Description: Set to true if accessing over plain HTTP on your LAN (not HTTPS).

Config.Name: HTTPS Enabled
Config.Description: Enable HTTPS. Requires SSL certificates mounted at the certs path.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, e.g. America/New_York

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the container as. 99 = nobody (Unraid default).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the container as. 100 = users (Unraid default).

Config.Name: Discord Notifications
Config.Description: Enable Discord webhook notifications.

Config.Name: Discord Webhook URL
Config.Description: Discord webhook URL for server notifications. Only used if DISCORD_ENABLED is true.

Config.Name: Rate Limit Max Requests
Config.Description: Maximum number of requests per rate limit window.

Config.Name: Rate Limit Window (ms)
Config.Description: Rate limit window in milliseconds (default: 900000 = 15 minutes).

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database.

Config.Name: Servers
Config.Description: Storage for Hytale game server installations.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Storage for automated server backups.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Application and Prisma log output.

Config.Name: SSL Certificates
Config.Description: SSL certificate storage. Only needed if HTTPS_ENABLED is true.

Config.Name: Hytale Downloader
Config.Description: Storage for the Hytale downloader tool.
